prompts.canvas: Create one perfectly flat, seamless tileable paper material for a professional football management game's Matchday Print UI. This is a material texture, not a mockup. Top-down, orthographic, completely even lighting, full square canvas opaque. Restrained print/editorial aesthetic. Extremely fine sparse natural fibres, tiny low-contrast grain; quiet enough to read dense dark text. No text, letters, numbers, marks, graphics, pitch lines, borders, frame, shadows, folds, stains, objects, vignettes or gradients. Keep the entire surface one uniform specified tone with only very slight texture. LEVEL 1 CANVAS: subdued medium-light warm stone/kraft paper, overall colour #cbbca2. Slight grey earthiness, desaturated warm beige, clearly darker than ivory. Subtle tightly woven paper fibres rather than rough distress. The background board behind brighter content sheets. Must be full-bleed uniform warm stone and must NOT become creamy white.
